text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to rigorously hammering out basic 
training, Wonder Acute's running has 
improved remarkably. The next target: the 
Japan Dirt Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she seemed to have been tiring 
out rather easily as of late. She appeared 
to be using the meal-tracking app her 
Trainer recommended, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then nutritional balance shouldn't be the 
issue. Suspecting overwork, the Trainer 
deliberates on whether to continue 
training at the current pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seven-time GⅠ champion T.M. Opera O 
arrives. They decide to ask her for 
advice.
